results: Requirement N28 fully implemented and verified: hardware, OS, source, and fixture identities recorded alongside nanosecond-precision latency, CPU, RSS memory, disk footprint, cancellation, and saturation metrics.

Benchmark workload evaluation engine implemented in internal/gateway/benchmark.go supporting bounded concurrency worker pool, nanosecond-precision sampling, percentile calculation (p50, p90, p95, p99, max), and fail-closed saturation controls.

Formal scenario contract tests/scenarios/target-workload.json created with schema version 1, defining capacity boundaries (1 protected app, 5-10 users, <= 64 KiB payload limit, <= 200ms decision deadline) and overload thresholds.
Standalone and supervisor-integrated benchmark driver scripts/benchmark-local.mjs created with automated --verify assertions, gathering host metrics and publishing docs/evidence/performance.json.

Engine CLI flag -benchmark-workload and HTTP endpoints POST /api/v1/benchmark/run and /api/v1/benchmark/evaluate registered in cmd/policyhelix/main.go and cmd/policyhelix/router.go, proxied through scripts/serve-web.mjs.
Target bounded workload measured p95 latency < 6ms, well within the 200ms SLO deadline with 100% allow rate and zero errors.

Overload conditions strictly verified: payloads > 64 KiB rejected with HTTP 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE; deadline timeouts rejected with HTTP 504 DECISION_TIMEOUT; client cancellations handled with HTTP 499 REQUEST_CANCELLED; and worker saturation rejected with HTTP 429 SATURATION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED without queuing starvation.
Storage restart recovery verified intact under load without data loss or rollback gap.
Ten Apache-2.0 synthetic fixtures cataloged with SHA-256 digests in tests/fixtures/policyhelix/C28/manifest.json.
observed_limitations: Maximum sustained single request payload is strictly capped at 64 KiB (65,536 bytes); larger payloads are rejected fail-closed.
Decision deadline SLO is bounded at 200ms; slower operations fail closed with HTTP 504.
Full clean-host core workflow, restart, and restore certification is scheduled for downstream task C30.
